reviewed_obligations.assessment: Pinned RV64 non-VM SimX definitions constrain 64-byte-aligned, disjoint allocation spans to [0x10000,0x200000000). Free plus used must equal 8589869056 bytes, with live allocated space and sufficient capacity. ABI encoding is exact 56-byte little-endian <8I3Q; three writes, one launch and one read are required. Successful profiled waits equal timeouts plus one, native P03 waits equal one, successful submissions remain incomplete until completion, and completion/close/resource-restoration statuses must succeed.
evidence: All address-outside/below-pool, zero-capacity, extra-wait and premature-complete W07 counterexamples reject on current source.

limits: Per-operation restoration does not prove exhaustive heap leak freedom.
